create_FunctionCallParser: create a FunctionCallParser instance with a list of tools and a detector name like 'llama3' or 'qwen'
test_has_tool_call: test the FunctionCallParser.has_tool_call method to check if text contains a tool call
parse_non_stream: parse non-streaming full text with FunctionCallParser.parse_non_stream to extract tool calls

review_get_structure_constraint: review FunctionCallParser.get_structure_constraint to get a constraint for guiding model output format
